fusions.name: Skitter Nip
fusions.desc: A quick nip that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Underfoot Scatter
fusions.desc: Darts through the pack, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Freeze Still
fusions.desc: Veils you for 5 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and you move 20% faster while veiled. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Quiet Hooves
fusions.desc: When you cover ground, your critical hit chance rises 15% for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
